anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, gently sloping convex arc transitioning from the dorsal ridge toward the rostrum junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak structure with a low length-to-width ratio, exhibiting a blunt distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse indentation at the junction where the melon's slope meets the rostrum's dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple pale linear striations and localized circular depigmented markings consistent with rake marks or superficial abrasions on the mid-to-upper flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent ocular region with visible eye placement posterior to the rostrum; visible anterior portion of the right pectoral fin.
